items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 05 May 2026 at 12:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, with shallow area of low pressure near Scotland, driving weak frontal zones across the area.


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, occasionally force 5 in the northwest, then veering east or southeast 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate in the northwest tonight.


##Weather##

Generally fair with isolated showers, patchy light rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 to 5, decreasing 2 or 3 during the afternoon, increasing 3 to 5 on Wednesday night, veering south or southeast later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, increasing slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, with a risk of occasional rain on Thursday morning.


##Visibility##

Good.
